name: Pathways: Navigating Gaming, the Internet and Extremism
source: Educational visual novel made as a part of a British Government's program Prevent, which explores harmful content on the internet and aims to discourage young people from following extremist ideas it generates.
translation: 教育视觉小说是英国政府“预防”计划的一部分，该计划探索互联网上的有害内容，旨在阻止年轻人追随其产生的极端主义思想。
